2609.14741.title: A property-registry contract for retrieve-or-refuse thermal-mechanical lattice search
2609.14741.paper_summary: Early thermal-mechanical lattice requirements are knowledge-intensive and often jointly unsatisfiable: an engineer asks for a cell that is light, stiff, laterally conducting and cheap, and no cell in the library satisfies it. A design system should say so, and say which requirement to loosen and by how much, rather than return the nearest row. A generative model can return a candidate even when the library holds none. This work applies established conflict diagnosis to a catalogue of homogenised properties. Search over 1,397 homogenised unit cells and 19 base materials (26,543 combinations) returns a catalogue row that a second solver can rebuild, or, for an empty feasible set of at most eight constraints, inclusion-minimal unsatisfiable subsets (MUS) and the slack of a repair, not a neighbour. One registry declaration generates the prompt and the evaluator, so undeclared parsed keys cannot reach search. On a frozen suite of 64 typed queries, retrieve-or-refuse matches min-repair on every feasible query (48/48) and refuses every empty one (16/16) with MUS and slack. Constraint-ignoring nearest-neighbour and penalty search violate stated cost or density limits. On 216 empty queries, repairs printed at three significant figures and rounded outward stay feasible in every case (216/216). When density and cost must be kept, a list of minimum-cardinality repairs keeps them on 209 of 211 queries; a protection-first repair keeps them on all 211, the same as full diagnosis. A 308-request parse benchmark is a template-text check, not unconstrained engineer prose.
2609.14741.paper_summary_zh: 早期的熱機械晶格需求是知識密集型的，並且通常是共同無法滿足的：一位工程師要求一個輕便、剛性強、側向導電且便宜的單元，但庫中的單元沒有一個滿足這些要求。設計系統應該指出這一點，並說明應該放寬哪個要求以及放寬多少，而不是返回最近的行。生成模型即使在庫中沒有任何單元的情況下也能返回一個候選者。這項工作將已建立的衝突診斷應用於一個均質性質的目錄。對1,397個均質單元和19種基材（26,543種組合）進行搜索，返回的目錄行可以被第二個求解器重建，或者對於最多八個約束的空可行集，包含最小不可滿足子集（MUS）和修復的鬆弛，而不是鄰居。一個登記聲明生成提示和評估器，因此未聲明的解析鍵無法進入搜索。在一組64個類型查詢的凍結套件上，檢索或拒絕在每個可行查詢上（48/48）匹配最小修復，並拒絕每個空查詢（16/16），並提供MUS和鬆弛。忽略約束的最近鄰和懲罰搜索違反了所述的成本或密度限制。在216個空查詢中，修復以三位有效數字打印並向外取整，在每種情況下都保持可行（216/216）。當必須保持密度和成本時，最小基數修復的列表在211個查詢中的209個上保持它們；一個以保護為先的修復在所有211個查詢上保持它們，與全面診斷相同。308個請求的解析基準是一個模板文本檢查，而不是不受約束的工程師散文。
